## Emoji drawn where an icon would be

Contexts: `standalone` is the whole text of an element, `icon-key` is a PHP `'icon' =>` value, `label` leads a text label, `list` is a row of five or more (a picker, a flag list). A *text symbol* (✓ ✕ ★) is drawn by the font, not as colour emoji.

| Glyph | Uses | Contexts | Modules | Text symbol |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 💬 | 38 | icon-key 7, label 4, inline 11, standalone 15, list 1 | admin, auth-onboarding, goconnect, gomarket, home, profile, public-landing, shell, static-pages |  |

| → | 32 | inline 18, label 14 | auth-onboarding, goconnect, gomarket, home, people, public-landing, shared, shell, solidarity | yes |
